schema_note: No official schema was published for this hackathon; shape proposed in our backlog (D-12): where each sponsor sits, as the sponsor overviews ask. Every value here is also stated in README.md (tests/test_metadata.py checks it).

project.name: VEDA
project.summary: A multi-agent system for flood-prone Kelantan, Malaysia: it cross-checks scattered and sometimes stale flood data and answers, in English or Bahasa Melayu, "Is my place at risk in the next 24–48 hours, and what should we do now?", with every claim traced to its source and age.
project.disclaimer: Not an official flood warning. Decision support only. Always follow JPS, APM and police instructions. Emergency: 999 · APM (Civil Defence): 991.
project.notice: NOTICE (Apache-2.0 Meterless ports; OpenStreetMap data under the ODbL)

agents.name: Coordinator
agents.role: Finds the place, picks the answer language, decides quick or full and writes the plan; writes the short explanation on the full path.
agents.uses: AI for the explanation only; plan and routing in code

agents.name: Data & Reconciler
agents.role: Fetches every source through Zetaris in parallel, checks freshness and plausibility, reconciles disagreeing sources, heals (backup gauge, last reading, INSUFFICIENT DATA), circuit breaker per source.

agents.name: Forecast
agents.role: Applies the verdict rules to the controlling gauges, upstream gauges and rain; builds the 24 h outlook, the confidence and the comparison with past floods.

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Code checks and a Zetaris re-check on every answer; a small AI review of the explanation against the card's key facts when the model replies in time.

agents.name: Safety gate
agents.role: Last check on every answer: never NORMAL on unusable data, no advice into water, disclaimer with 999 / 991, ranges only, replay title, never 'a PPS is open' or 'the road will be cut off'.

agent_framework: none - plain Python agents driven by a small state machine (app/loop.py)

zetaris.role: The data layer: every agent reads data only through run_sql() - Postgres veda_pg (gauges, thresholds, places, peaks, live JPS levels, replay rows, OpenStreetMap features), REST tables (Open-Meteo, data.gov.my) and views.

meterless_engine.role: VEDA's shared, provenance-stamped memory between agents: readings and forecast facts with source and time, source health and circuit breakers, the Forecast agent's stored verdict, the Critic's reviews, the question radar (intent tags only).

meterless_nightshift.role: The only AI provider: OpenAI-format HTTP, model route meterless/fast, app id veda-fast, streaming; every call's trace line names the model that actually answered and the Nightshift receipt id.

nvidia.role: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning writes the explanation and does the Critic's AI review, served through Nightshift; no other model answers in VEDA.

cursor.role: AI coding tool: Claude Code (Anthropic) inside Cursor, with the Cursor agent for a few small delegated jobs (logged in docs/cursor-log.md).

data_sources.name: OpenStreetMap
data_sources.mode: loaded once at setup; SAMPLE_MODE fixture

sample_mode.what: Runs the real agent logic offline on scenes (Nov 2024 replay, SYNTHETIC scenes) and recorded open / synthetic fixtures, with no calls to Zetaris, Nightshift or anything else; the models are replaced by the agents' code fallbacks.
sample_mode.needs: Python 3.13 and requirements.txt; no .env, no keys
